requests.description:
Description: This operation retrieves all Account Types for the specified country.
Purpose: Provides access to the Account Types including id and type description.
requests.name: GET /api/AccountTypes

requests.description:
Description: This operation retrieves all Account Types for the specified id.
Purpose: Provides access to the Account Types including id and type description.
requests.name: GET /api/AccountTypes/{id}
requests.note: Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description:
Description: This operation retrieves all Accounts for the specified Fact Finder ID and/or external source ID.
Purpose: Provides access to the Account information including description and market value.
requests.name: GET /api/Accounts

requests.description:
Description: The operation creates an Account.
Purpose: Allows for creation of Accounts on a Fact Finder.
requests.name: POST /api/Accounts

requests.description: Retrieves all holdings in the specified Account.
requests.name: GET /api/Accounts/{accountId}/Holdings
requests.note: Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Creates a holding and adds it to an existing Account.
requests.name: POST /api/Accounts/{accountId}/Holdings
requests.note: Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Updates all holdings associated with an account
requests.name: PUT /api/Accounts/{accountId}/Holdings
requests.note: Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description:
Description: This operation deletes a single Account Holding for the specified Account Holding ID and Account ID.
Purpose: Provides the ability to remove individual holdings from a specified Account.
requests.name: DELETE /api/Accounts/{accountId}/Holdings/{id}
requests.note: Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description:
Description: This operation retrieves a single Account Holding for the specified Account Holding ID and Account ID.
Purpose: Provides access to the Account Holding information including description and market value.
requests.name: GET /api/Accounts/{accountId}/Holdings/{id}
requests.note: Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Updates a holding associated with an account
requests.name: PUT /api/Accounts/{accountId}/Holdings/{id}
requests.note: Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Deletes all savings strategies tied to an account
requests.name: DELETE /api/Accounts/{accountId}/SavingsStrategies
requests.note: Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Get all of the savings strategies for a specific account
requests.name: GET /api/Accounts/{accountId}/SavingsStrategies
requests.note: Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Creates a savings strategy on a specific account
requests.name: POST /api/Accounts/{accountId}/SavingsStrategies
requests.note: Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Deletes a specific savings strategy
requests.name: DELETE /api/Accounts/{accountId}/SavingsStrategies/{id}
requests.note: Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Get a specific savings strategy for an account
requests.name: GET /api/Accounts/{accountId}/SavingsStrategies/{id}
requests.note: Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Updates a specific savings strategy
requests.name: PUT /api/Accounts/{accountId}/SavingsStrategies/{id}
requests.note: Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description:
Description: The operation removes an Account tied to a Fact Finder.
Purpose: Allows for removal of an Account from a Fact Finder.
requests.name: DELETE /api/Accounts/{id}
requests.note: Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description:
Description: This operation retrieves a single Account for the specified Account ID.
Purpose: Provides access to the Account information including description and market value.
requests.name: GET /api/Accounts/{id}
requests.note: Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description:
Description: The operation updates an Account, deletes associated saving strategies if the account type changes.
Purpose: Allows for complete replacement of an Account on a Fact Finder.
requests.name: PUT /api/Accounts/{id}
